description: International context bundle for scheduling, invoicing and coordination across borders. Combines timezone conversion, holiday calendar and currency exchange in one call. Returns DST-correct local time with offset, upcoming public holidays and exchange rate. Sources: IANA TZDB, Nager.Date API, European Central Bank. Price $0.003 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"country":"US","timezone":"America/New_York","local_time":{"datetime":"2026-03-15T08:00:00","utc_offset":"-04:00"},"holidays":{"year":2026,"count":11,"upcoming":[{"date":"2026-05-25","name":"Memorial Day"},{"date":"2026-07-04","name":"Independence Day"}]},"exchange_rate":{"from":"USD","to":"EUR","r

timestamp.description: Optional ISO datetime or 'now', default now

year.description: Optional year for holidays, default current year

name: agent_context
